# The bundled git's path safety corpus (DESIGN-COMPUTE §13.7; GIT-M13-01's TestPathSafetyCorpus).
#
# Each line: a verdict, a Go-quoted path, and optionally the entry's octal mode (100644 when left out), then a comment.
#   refuse    gitCheckPath refuses it, and stock git's fsck --strict refuses a tree holding it
#   stricter  gitCheckPath refuses it while stock git's fsck passes it (the bundled git refuses more)
#   allow     both pass it
# A path no tree can hold (absolute, an empty name) is held to gitCheckPath alone. Grouped by the advisory or rule:
#   CVE-2014-9390 (.git in any case, HFS+'s ignorable code points, NTFS's 8.3 name), CVE-2019-1352 and CVE-2019-1353
#   (NTFS alternate data streams, trailing dots and spaces on .git), CVE-2018-11235 and CVE-2019-1354 (.gitmodules as a
#   link, backslashes as separators on Windows), CVE-2024-32002 and CVE-2024-32004 (case-folding names and links, a path
#   through a link, which the worktree refuses as it writes: TestCaseFoldCollision), CVE-2025-48384 (a CR at a path's
#   end, which reached .git/config unquoted through a submodule's path: the bundled git writes no submodule's path,
#   and its config writer refuses a CR in any value, so the path itself is passed as fsck passes it).

refuse ".."
refuse "../outside"
refuse "a/../b"
refuse "."
refuse "a/./b"
refuse ".git"
refuse ".git/config"
refuse ".GIT/config"
refuse ".Git/hooks/pre-commit"
refuse "sub/.git/config"
refuse "sub/.gIt"
refuse ".git."
refuse ".git..."
refuse ".git . ."
refuse ".git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION/config"
refuse ".git:stream"
refuse "git~1/config"
refuse "GIT~1"
refuse "sub/Git~1/hooks"
refuse ".g\u200cit/config"
refuse "\u200c.git"
refuse ".git\u200d"
refuse ".gi\u202et/config"
refuse ".g\u206ait"
refuse ".git\ufeff/config"
refuse ".gitmodules" 120000 a link named .gitmodules
refuse ".GITMODULES" 120000 in another case
refuse "sub/.gitmodules" 120000 in a subdirectory
refuse "sub\\.git\\config" .git after a backslash, which fsck reads as NTFS's separator
refuse "gitmod~1" 120000 NTFS's 8.3 name of .gitmodules
refuse "GI7EBA~1" 120000 NTFS's fallback 8.3 name of .gitmodules
refuse ".gitmodules. " 120000 trailing dot and space

stricter "\uff0e\uff47\uff49\uff54/config" a fullwidth .git
stricter ".g\u0130t" a dotted capital I
stricter ".gi\u0074\u0301" a combining acute on the t
stricter "a\\..\\b" backslashes, separators on Windows
stricter "C:" a drive prefix
stricter "C:/x"
stricter "z:file"

refuse "" no path at all
refuse "/etc/passwd" absolute
refuse "a//b" an empty name
refuse "a/" a trailing slash
refuse "a/\x00/b" a NUL

allow "README.md"
allow ".gitignore"
allow ".gitattributes"
allow ".gitmodules" a regular .gitmodules
allow ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
allow "dir.git/x"
allow "x.git"
allow ".gitx"
allow "git"
allow "git~2"
allow "git~10"
allow "foo:bar"
allow "a b/c d.txt"
allow "\u00fcnic\u00f6de/\u0444\u0430\u0439\u043b.txt"
allow "sub\r" a CR at the end, passed as fsck passes it (CVE-2025-48384)
allow "...txt"
allow "..txt"
allow ".hidden"
allow "a/b/c/d/e/f/g.txt"
